title: Uptime Kotlin
description: Health of the monitor itself: Probe Checks, workers, queues, CPU and memory, notifications, API.

links.title: Prometheus alerts
links.tooltip: Every alert rule and its state

list.name: prometheus_url
list.label: Prometheus URL
list.description: Used by the header link. Change it in the dashboard settings, Variables.

list.name: app_url
list.label: Uptime Kotlin URL
list.description: Used by the header link. Change it in the dashboard settings, Variables.

list.name: instance
list.label: Instance
list.description: Filters what each process measures itself: checks run, CPU, memory, API. Not the probes, queues and alerts, read from the shared database.

list.name: region
list.label: Region
list.description: Worker region (SCHEDULER_WORKER_NAME). Filters the worker panels.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Alerts of deploy/monitoring/alerts.yml firing now. They are also drawn as red bands on every graph. Same value for every instance (shared database): the Instance filter does not apply.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity, subject) (label_join(ALERTS_FOR_STATE{alertname=~"UptimeKotlin.*"} and ignoring (alertstate) ALERTS{alertstate="firing",alertname=~"UptimeKotlin.*"}, "subject", "", "instance", "worker", "queue", "channel", "protocol"))

panels.title: Monitoring
panels.description: Down: the Probe Checks are not run (no active worker, or the queue lags by more than a minute). Degraded: any other alert firing, listed above. OK: no alert. Same value for every instance (shared database): the Instance filter does not apply.

panels.title: Probes failing
panels.description: Enabled probes whose last check failed. Same value for every instance (shared database): the Instance filter does not apply.

panels.title: Checks on schedule
panels.description: Checks run per minute by all the instances over 15 minutes, and the share of the expected checks (60 / interval for every enabled probe) that were not run. Retries of failing probes add checks and can hide a shortfall. Same value for every instance (shared database): the Instance filter does not apply.

links.title: Open Checks per minute, by result

panels.title: Technical errors
panels.description: Checks that threw instead of producing a result, over the selected period: a problem of Uptime Kotlin, not of the monitored service (see the worker logs). Failing probes are counted apart.

links.title: Open Checks per minute, by result

panels.title: Check queue lag
panels.description: Age of the oldest due Probe Check nobody has claimed yet. A few seconds at most when all is well. Same value for every instance (shared database): the Instance filter does not apply.

panels.title: Workers
panels.description: Instances running the Probe Checks (workers and all-in-one). Silent: no heartbeat for 30 s, their checks move to the others; listed for an hour, then purged. Filtered by Region, not by Instance.

panels.title: Processes
panels.description: API and worker processes answering Prometheus on their management port. Details in Instances.

panels.title: Dead-lettered tasks
panels.description: Probe Checks and notifications that reached their maximum delivery attempts: they will not be retried. Same value for every instance (shared database): the Instance filter does not apply.

panels.title: Failed notifications
panels.description: Failed delivery attempts over the selected period. A retried delivery counts once per attempt.

panels.title: Checks per minute, by result
panels.description: Averaged over 5 minutes. Dashed: the checks the enabled probes should produce. Below it for long: checks are missed. error: the check threw instead of producing a result (see the worker logs).

panels.title: Check duration · mean, by protocol
panels.description: Wall-clock duration of a check, timeout included, averaged over 5 minutes.

panels.title: Probes now, by state
panels.description: State of the last check of each probe. Refreshed every 30 s from the database. Same value for every instance (shared database): the Instance filter does not apply.

panels.title: Workers · heartbeat age
panels.description: One lane per worker, coloured by the age of its last heartbeat (written every 10 s): green up to 20 s, orange up to 30 s, red beyond: silent, its checks move to the others. Hover for the age. A worker stopped on purpose stays listed for an hour before its heartbeat is purged. Filtered by Region, not by Instance.

panels.title: Worker saturation
panels.description: Running checks / SCHEDULER_WORKER_CONCURRENCY. Above the line for long: add workers or concurrency. Filtered by Region, not by Instance.

panels.title: Queue lag
panels.description: Age of the oldest due task waiting to be claimed. The line is the alert threshold of the Probe Checks. Same value for every instance (shared database): the Instance filter does not apply.

panels.title: Queues now
panels.description: Scheduled includes the next run of every enabled probe. Given up: maximum delivery attempts reached, never retried. Same value for every instance (shared database): the Instance filter does not apply.

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: Every API and worker process scraped by Prometheus. Several versions at once: a rolling upgrade is unfinished. Restarts in a loop show here first.

targets.expr: max by (job, role, instance, version) ((up{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"}) * on (job, instance) group_left (version) uptime_build_info{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"} or on (job, instance) label_replace((up{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"}), "version", "unknown", "", ""))

max by (job, role, instance, version) ((time() - (uptime_process_start_time_seconds{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"} or on (job, instance) process_start_time_seconds{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"})) * on (job, instance) group_left (version) uptime_build_info{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"} or on (job, instance) label_replace((time() - (uptime_process_start_time_seconds{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"} or on (job, instance) process_start_time_seconds{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"})), "version", "unknown", "", ""))

max by (job, role, instance, version) (((changes(uptime_process_start_time_seconds{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"}[$__range]) or on (job, instance) changes(process_start_time_seconds{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"}[$__range]))) * on (job, instance) group_left (version) uptime_build_info{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"} or on (job, instance) label_replace(((changes(uptime_process_start_time_seconds{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"}[$__range]) or on (job, instance) changes(process_start_time_seconds{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"}[$__range]))), "version", "unknown", "", ""))

max by (job, role, instance, version) ((process_cpu_usage{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"}) * on (job, instance) group_left (version) uptime_build_info{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"} or on (job, instance) label_replace((process_cpu_usage{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"}), "version", "unknown", "", ""))

max by (job, role, instance, version) ((process_resident_memory_bytes{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"}) * on (job, instance) group_left (version) uptime_build_info{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"} or on (job, instance) label_replace((process_resident_memory_bytes{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*"}), "version", "unknown", "", ""))

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of the CPUs available to the process.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: RAM actually used (VmRSS) against the container limit, dashed.

defaults.noValue: Linux only: no data under quarkusDev on macOS

panels.title: Heap used
panels.description: Saw teeth are the garbage collector at work. Native images publish fewer JVM metrics.

panels.title: Database connections
panels.description: Connection pool of each process. Waiting above 0 for long: raise QUARKUS_DATASOURCE_JDBC_MAX_SIZE.

panels.title: Host CPU
panels.description: CPU of the machine, or of the container, as seen by each process.

panels.title: Failed attempts, by channel
panels.description: Check the token or the webhook URL of the channel in Uptime Kotlin.

panels.title: Notification queue lag
panels.description: Age of the oldest notification due and not sent yet. The line is the alert threshold. Same value for every instance (shared database): the Instance filter does not apply.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Quarkus publishes no latency histogram by default: mean and slowest request only.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*",instance=~"$instance",uri!~"/q/.*"}[5m])) / sum by (method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=~"uptime-kotlin.*",instance=~"$instance",uri!~"/q/.*"}[5m])))
